# TEP-VOID Data File Manifest
#
# This file provides a complete inventory of ALL data files used in the
# TEP-VOID analysis pipeline (Paper 31: Cosmological Voids vs Isochrony
# Violation).
#
# Data is organized into three tiers:
#   raw/       — Downloaded or curated input data (never modified by pipeline)
#   interim/   — Intermediate processing outputs (regenerated by pipeline)
#   processed/ — Final processed catalogs ready for analysis
#

## INPUT DATA (Downloaded by Pipeline)

data/raw/Pantheon+SH0ES.dat
  Source: Scolnic et al. (2022) ApJ 938 113 / Riess et al. (2022) ApJ 934 L7
  Role: Primary input — Cepheid and SN Ia distances (SH0ES distance ladder)
  Status: Downloaded from https://github.com/PantheonPlusSH0ES/DataRelease
  Ingestion: step_00_data_ingestion.py

data/raw/external/trgb_distances_freedman2024.csv
  Source: Freedman et al. (2024) CCHP
  Role: TRGB distance moduli for indicator divergence comparison
  Status: Published data from Chicago-Carnegie Hubble Program
  Ingestion: step_00_data_ingestion.py

data/raw/external/velocity_dispersions_literature.csv
  Source: HyperLEDA galaxy database (Makarov et al. 2014, A&A 570, A13)
  Role: Kinematic potential proxy — sigma_kms column is the declared
        potential-equivalent scale u_phi = V_rot / sqrt(2), computed
        from HyperLEDA inclination-corrected maximum rotation velocity.
        NOT a measured central stellar velocity dispersion. Source
        V_rot and catalog uncertainty preserved in vrot_kms /
        vrot_error_kms columns. Filename retained for historical
        pipeline compatibility.
  Status: Curated from HyperLEDA; rows 1–37 are the complete R22
          SN-host set; final rows are ladder anchors.
  Ingestion: step_01_host_potential_catalog.py

data/raw/external/cf4_table2.dat
  Source: Tully et al. (2023) CosmicFlows-4, CDS J/ApJ/944/94
  Role: 55,877 individual galaxy distances (all methodologies)
  Status: Downloaded from CDS archive via Playwright (bypasses Anubis protection)
  Size: 10.4 MB (decompressed from 2.4 MB gz)
  Ingestion: step_02_cosmicflows_ingestion.py

data/raw/external/cf4_table4.dat
  Source: Tully et al. (2023) CosmicFlows-4, CDS J/ApJ/944/94
  Role: 38,053 galaxy groups with peculiar velocities
  Status: Downloaded from CDS archive via Playwright (bypasses Anubis protection)
  Size: 6.0 MB (decompressed from 2.5 MB gz)
  Ingestion: step_02_cosmicflows_ingestion.py

data/raw/external/cf4_readme.txt
  Source: CDS ReadMe for J/ApJ/944/94
  Role: Column format documentation for CF4 tables
  Ingestion: step_02_cosmicflows_ingestion.py

data/raw/external/mazurenko_curves/
  Source: Mazurenko, Banik & Kroupa 2025, MNRAS 536, 3232–3241, Figure 3
  Role: Digitized (z, H0) points for the Gaussian and Exponential
        void-density-profile H0(z) curves ("Method-3" full-GR, HBK20
        best-fitting void parameters). Used for the redshift-decay
        profile comparison and digitization-sensitivity analysis.
  Contents: mazurenko_curves_all.csv (388 rows),
            gaussian_method3.json, exponential_method3.json,
            gaussian_method3_cleaned.json, gaussian_method3_fitted.json,
            maxwell_boltzmann_method3.json, cleaning_log.json
  Ingestion: step_32_redshift_decay_profile.py, step_32b_jia_validation.py,
             step_34_void_boundary_test.py

## SHARED DATA (from companion paper TEP-H0, Paper 11)

# The following data products are generated by the TEP-H0 pipeline and
# referenced by TEP-VOID for the single-galaxy differential tests and
# the 37-host endpoint likelihood. They are NOT re-downloaded here.
#
# TEP-H0 data/processed/hosts_processed.csv
#   Source: TEP-H0 step_01_data_ingestion.py
#   Role: 37-host SH0ES catalog with matched metadata
#
# TEP-H0 results/outputs/step_10_m31_analysis.json
#   Source: TEP-H0 step_10_m31_analysis.py
#   Role: M31 inner vs outer Cepheid P-L offset
#
# TEP-H0 results/outputs/step_14_lmc_replication.json
#   Source: TEP-H0 step_14_lmc_replication.py
#   Role: LMC radial stratification result
